title: Masseter Prime
extract:
Masseter Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Masseter crankshaft heavy blade, acting as a direct upgrade. Masseter Prime was released alongside  Grendel Prime and  Zylok Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Rending Crane and  Noble Cadence (Conclave only) stance.
Melee Stance slams without the full slam visual, such as those from  Cleaving Whirlwind's Sundered Tusk combo, have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo and have the ability to crit.
Melee stance slams with the full slam visual have the ability to crit, but do not have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo.

Acquisition

Notes
When wielded by  Grendel/ Grendel Prime, he is immune to crowd control procs during Heavy Attacks.
Has a uniquely large slam radius compared to other weapons of the same class.
Slam attacks cause Ragdoll against enemies.
Under Heavy Blades, the Melee Combo dependent damage multiplier and ability to deal critical hits on Melee Stance 'mini' slams is only shared by  Gram Prime,  Masseter and  Paracesis
On other weapons, these hits only deal minimal damage as they are unaffected by mods other than  Seismic Wave.

Trivia
The masseter muscle is one of four muscles responsible for chewing.
Keeping with  Grendel's design being inspired by Oni, the Masseter Prime's design is based on the Kanabō, a studded, two-handed club used by samurai. The cumbersome nature of the kanabō resulted in the weapon being associated with oni due to their great strength.
The close associations between oni and kanabō in Japanese culture have resulted in the phrase oni-ni-kanabō (鬼に金棒, "[giving a] kanabō to oni") to describe giving further advantages to a powerful opponent, which may be the basis for Grendel's immunity to crowd control effects while preparing a heavy attack with the Masseter.
When the Masseter Prime is used to perform an attack, the blade's rotation will ramp up for a short period of time and eventually slow back to idle speed.
Manually guarding will lock the Masseter Prime's blade in place until guarding is released, regardless of current speed.
